ValidationRule.description: Checks whether an opportunity has the required information to be considered as Closed Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Type, ''), ISPICKVAL(Account.TypeOfBusiness__c, ''), ISBLANK(Account.ShippingPostalCode), DecisionMakerContactRoleSetHelper__c = FALSE, PrimaryContactFunctionSet__c = FALSE, ISBLANK(Account.EmailInvoiceTo__c), ISPICKVAL(Account.InvoiceType__c, ''), ISBLANK(Account.SupervisedByTenantUserID__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Mandatory fields are required to close this Opportunity. Please check the "New Customer Notification" tab.
